ADCode is our free, open-source code editor for Windows + Linux. Bring your own AI key or a compatible local model.

The idea is “get paid to build”: occasional sponsored cards fund the editor, and 50% of the ad revenue attributed to you is credited to you. Earnings vary; cloud AI costs are separate.
